comparator.name: Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: Current 2026–2027 ordinary generic Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences is verified as 60 EC compulsory first-year foundations + 60 EC compulsory second-year study + 14 EC final-year compulsory modern-drug-development and academic skills + 16 EC bachelor research (practical12, thesis3, presentation1) + 30 EC genuine approved open elective space = 180 EC. No named route is selected: the least specialised ordinary BFW pathway preserves the official minor/elective space independently of UCR fit. Pharmacy is an optional selective direction requiring at least80 EC and completed practical exercises; its five30-EC modules replace open space only for admitted participants and are not compulsory for all BFW students. Self-composed packages, other-institution minors and later changes need examination-board approval. Research entry requires all first-year units/propedeuse and second-year practical units; one outstanding practical may permit a restricted research offering depending on prior knowledge. The research period is continuous and may not be combined with other courses/practicals. All37 counted components occur once; the16-EC research parent is not added to its12/3/1 subparts.
